note: A demonstration run of the four P0 skills. Real artifacts, real validation verdicts, real latencies. NOT a benchmark: six of the eight dimensions need gold labels the repository does not ship.

dimensions.label: Task Success
dimensions.definition: Share of cases whose objective was met, judged against a gold answer. Requires the benchmark corpus.

dimensions.label: Evidence Grounding
dimensions.definition: Whether claims rest on evidence that licenses them, and whether that evidence is cited. Requires gold answers.

dimensions.label: Provenance Completeness
dimensions.definition: Pinned sources, identified licences, four version axes, and every cited item traceable to a declared card.

dimensions.label: Reproducibility
dimensions.definition: Re-running the same input yields the same artifact digest.

dimensions.label: Safety and Abstention
dimensions.definition: Whether high-risk signals are surfaced and unsafe conclusions declined. Requires gold labels.

dimensions.label: Claim Calibration
dimensions.definition: Whether the system refuses claims its evidence cannot support, and makes none it cannot support.

dimensions.label: Latency
dimensions.definition: Wall-clock seconds per case. Reported raw.

gates.name: severe safety false-negative rate above threshold
gates.rule: severe safety false-negative rate above threshold

gates.name: fabricated citation rate is not zero
gates.rule: fabricated citation rate is not zero

gates.name: a clinical efficacy conclusion rested on prediction-only evi
gates.rule: a clinical efficacy conclusion rested on prediction-only evidence

aggregation.formula: n / sum(1 / s_i) over the eight dimensions
aggregation.note: dominated by the weakest dimension, so a system must be good at provenance and safety together
